## Go over the syllabus
Please go over the [syllabus](/syllabus/about.html) to familiarize yourself with the course policies, grading scheme and other important information.
::: 

| Week | Prince material | Main topic |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Chapters 1–2 | ML framing and supervised learning |
| 2 | Chapter 3 | Shallow neural networks |
| 3 | Chapter 4 | Deep networks and representations |
| 4 | Chapter 5 | Likelihood and loss functions |
| 5 | Chapters 6–7 | Optimization, backpropagation and micrograd |
| 6 | Chapters 8–9 | Generalization and regularization |
| 7 | Chapter 10 | Convolutions and image models |
| 8 | Selected Chapter 11 | Residual connections and normalization |
| 9 | Chapter 12.1–12.3 | Tokens, embeddings and attention |
| 10 | Chapter 12.4–12.8 | Transformers, BERT and GPT |
| 11 | Chapter 14 | Generative-model framework |
| 12 | Chapter 18.1–18.3 | Forward and reverse diffusion |
| 13 | Chapter 18.4–18.6 | Training and implementation |
| 14 | — | Projects, comparison and synthesis |
